description: Implementation of the inter-slice scheduler for a 5G/NR network, managing resource allocation, slice prioritization, and UE management within a cellular network.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class implementing the inter-slice scheduling logic, resource management, and UE handling.

classes.name: inter_slice_scheduler::ran_slice_sched_context
classes.description: Represents the context and priority calculation for each slice during scheduling.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::inter_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing slices, priority queues, and slot ring based on cell configuration.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::slot_indication
methods.description: Updates slice contexts and priority queues based on the current slot and resource grid.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE and its bearers to the scheduler.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::reconf_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from slices during reconfiguration.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes all logical channels of a UE from all slices.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::config_applied
methods.description: Handles the application of new UE configurations, adding UEs to slices if valid.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::add_impl
methods.description: Internal method to add UE and logical channels to appropriate slices.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::fetch_ue_to_update
methods.description: Fetches a UE for update, ensuring it is active and properly configured.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_slice
methods.description: Retrieves the slice instance based on logical channel configuration.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_candidate
methods.description: Generic method to get the next UL or DL slice candidate based on priority queues.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_dl_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next downlink slice candidate.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_next_ul_candidate
methods.description: Retrieves the next uplink slice candidate.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::handle_slice_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Processes slice reconfiguration requests, updating RRM policies.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::get_nof_used_reserved_rbs
methods.description: Calculates the number of reserved RBs used in a given slot for UL or DL.

methods.name: inter_slice_scheduler::ran_slice_sched_context::get_prio
methods.description: Calculates the priority of a slice candidate based on multiple factors like slot distance, RBs, and delay.
